title: Ya-Sin 36:25-28 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y10 lesson 17 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Ya-Sin 36:25-28 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 17. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: إِنِّىٓ ءَامَنتُ بِرَبِّكُمْ فَٱسْمَعُونِ (٢٥) قِيلَ ٱدْخُلِ ٱلْجَنَّةَ ۖ قَالَ يَٰلَيْتَ قَوْمِى يَعْلَمُونَ (٢٦)
بِمَا غَفَرَ لِى رَبِّى وَجَعَلَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ (٢٧) ۞ وَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ مِن جُندٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا كُنَّا مُنزِلِينَ (٢٨)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: Indeed, I have believed in your Lord, so listen to me."
It was said, "Enter Paradise." He said, "I wish my people could know
Of how my Lord has forgiven me and placed me among the honored."
And We did not send down upon his people after him any soldiers from the heaven, nor would We have done so.

head: Word
Where
Rule
How to read it
rows: Madd munfasil, then a badal madd
Hamzat al-wasl: laam takes a kasrah
Ikhfa (ن before ج); idgham with ghunnah

questions.q: Chunk and link Ya-Sin 36:25-28 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 36:25-28 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 36:25-28 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: Check: recite Ya-Sin 36:13 to 24 (home hifdh) to a partner and note any slips.
questions.a: Pupil recites 36:13 to 24; slips noted for the teacher.

questions.q: Explain 36:28: why did Allah not need to send an army against that people?
questions.a: One blast was enough (36:29); Allah's power needs no army.

questions.q: What did the believing man wish (36:26 to 27)?
options: That his people knew how Allah forgave and honoured him
That he could return to fight them
questions.a: A) That his people knew how Allah forgave and honoured him. 36:26 to 27.

questions.q: Ya-Sin 36:25: «إِنِّىٓ ءَامَنتُ ...» Which word comes next?
Think again: The man from the far end of the city was killed for his faith, yet his first wish in Paradise was: 'I wish my people could know' (36:26). What does that tell you about him?
questions.a: He held no grudge; he still wanted good for the people who harmed him: sincere care for others.
